title: The overhead press: what it REALLY works 🏋️
caption:
Shoulders, triceps, upper chest and back, and standing up your core works hard too. Standing or seated? Comment which you do 👇

Exercise Series, Part 5
sources: Saeterbakken AH, Fimland MS. Effects of body position and loading modality on muscle activity and strength in shoulder presses. J Strength Cond Res 2013;27:1824-1831 (standing: higher deltoid activity; seated: higher 1RM)
